verdict.rationale: Terminal payments are managed alongside online payments in Stripe. Stripe offers an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API, plus an OpenAPI spec, a CLI and webhooks, so an agent could plausibly pull payment and payout data. Payouts to a bank account are documented, but nothing shows APIs or reports that tie payouts to the transactions they settle, or any export or sync into a ledger. missing for 10: documented API for listing payouts with their constituent transactions (balance/settlement detail), reconciliation reports or daily-takings summaries, accounting/ledger integration, hands-on corroboration of an agent doing reconciliation.
